# Thanks to the talent of EAFIT students, we are the best private university in Antioquia.

**This was established in the most recent ranking for Latin America by the firm Quacquarelli Symonds, in which EAFIT was ranked second in the department, after the U. de A., and is in the top 10 best in the country.**

**The reputation among employers and the employability of graduates are the best scores for the U in that ranking, which is related to the routes for connecting and training talent led by the Directorate of Institutional Development and Links.**

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [News](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias)
- Thanks to the talent of EAFIT students, we are the best private university in Antioquia.

![Image: Thanks to the talent of EAFIT students, we are the best private university in Antioquia](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/9b2c4190-9405-405e-ab7f-645ce576a73a/web/ranquinqs.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=823&h=450&itok=fLs8LxVy)

In another of the rankings by the firm Quacquarelli Symonds, the World University Ranking, EAFIT is currently ranked 731-740 globally, and sixth in Colombia.

Four EAFIT graduates appear on Bloomberg's list of the 500 most influential people in Latin America 2023, published on September 18. They are: María Cristina Arrastía, Vice President of Business at Grupo Bancolombia; José Darío Uribe, President of the Latin American Reserve Fund; Juan Carlos Mora, CEO of Grupo Bancolombia; and Carlos Ignacio Gallego, CEO of Grupo Nutresa. The first three are business administrators, while the last is a civil engineer with a master's degree in administration.

The list, now in its third edition, is compiled taking into account factors such as "job creation, investments or innovations that helped to trigger relevant economic activity, and influence in various sectors."

The inclusion of EAFIT graduates in this selection—which includes 59 Colombians—reflects one of the most recognized characteristics of EAFIT alumni: their leadership. This aligns with one of the institution's most highly valued attributes in university rankings. On September 13, the QS Latin America & The Caribbean University Rankings 2024 were released, in which EAFIT ranked first among private universities in the department, ninth in the country, and 62nd in the Americas. And, as is typical for our institution in these rankings, our highest scores were in employer reputation and graduate employability.

These results, as expressed by Claudia Restrepo Montoya, rector of EAFIT, demonstrate the path the University has taken to maintain its DNA of connection with the business system and the strengthening of ties with society, thanks to a transformation process that prioritizes three systems: entrepreneurship, consolidated companies and public systems.

“One of our University’s superpowers is connectivity. Applicants, from any field of knowledge, seek us out because of the opportunity we offer to connect them with these systems,” says the Rector.

Isabel Gómez Yepes, Director of Institutional Development and Links at the University, adds that the results related to employability and reputation among employers, besides being received with joy, increase the commitment to continue working to ensure that the training processes at the Institution are the most relevant to face the challenges of society.

**This is how we established the connection.**

Early connections are one of the actions implemented at EAFIT to go beyond talent development and reach the point of actual job placement. This is according to Juliana Gutiérrez Aristizabal, Head of Talent at EAFIT, who explains that the task of creating professional connections for university graduates doesn't begin when they receive their degree.

That task, she says, begins with the training process. In addition to the well-established professional internship requirement, the talent development pathway includes other models for building connections, such as early immersion in entrepreneurship, established companies, and public systems. “Organizations propose challenges that we analyze before issuing a call for applications, in which selected students are involved for a specific period,” says the EAFIT graduate, referring to a process already underway with organizations like Haceb, Renault, and Coordinadora.

One of the paths EAFIT University is exploring for its talent development program is entrepreneurship. The goal is that, through the university's entrepreneurship center, On.going, students will connect with the entrepreneurial process within their degree programs or include entrepreneurship among their practical experience options, given the numerous growth opportunities it offers.

In addition to networking, talent development is another area led by Juliana Gutiérrez, and therefore, besides thanking them for helping the University stand out in the rankings, the Office of Institutional Development and Partnerships invites graduates to strengthen their ties with the Institution, either to stay up-to-date or to find the talent their organizations need.

###### Viruses versus bacteria: PhageLife's proposal for the swine sector from EAFIT

On a pig farm, a bacterial infection can jeopardize the animals' health and the farm's productivity. Furthermore, the problem becomes more complex when the bacteria stop responding to the antibiotics that previously combated them. To explore another approach, the company [PhageLife](https://phagelife.co/) is developing customized solutions using bacteriophages, naturally occurring viruses capable of eliminating specific bacteria.

metadata.description: ​​​En el listado de las 500 personas más influyentes de América Latina 2023, que publicó el 18 de septiembre Bloomberg, figuran cuatro graduados eafitenses. María Cristina Arrastía, vicepresidenta de Negocios del Grupo Bancolombia, José Darío Uribe, presidente del Fondo Latinoamericano de Reservas, Juan Carlos Mora, presidente ejecutivo del Grupo Bancolombia, y Carlos Ignacio Gallego, presidente ejecutivo del Grupo Nutresa. Los tres primeros son administradores de negocios y el último es ingeniero civil y magíster en Administración.
metadata.ogTitle: Gracias al talento eafitense somos la mejor universidad privada de Antioquia
